svg.aria-label: OctoberBlue. Red attacks, blue defends, only the evidence decides. Red-side agents send an attack through an untrusted surface into a sandboxed target; the blue guard filters it; a trusted gateway denies the unauthorized tool call; an independent verifier scores the run from recorded events, not from any agent's claim.
